items.title: Draft the product brief
items.notes: Documented the target players and GMs, v1 goals and non-goals, and the definition of done.

items.title: Map the character workflows and screens
items.notes: Drafted ego creation, morph assignment, resleeving, and export flows, plus the information architecture and key screen requirements.

items.title: Outline the technical design and testing plan
items.notes: Sketched the TypeScript domain model, traced calculations, local-first storage, and planned verification layers.

items.title: Document delivery milestones and open decisions
items.notes: Published milestones and exit criteria from discovery through public beta.

items.title: Publish contributor documentation and the roadmap
items.notes: Added the documentation entry points, agent guidance, and versioned roadmap files.

items.title: Select and set up the React host framework
items.notes: Selected Vite with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Added a checked build, calculation tests, and local setup commands.

items.title: Save and reload a draft ego and sleeve
items.notes: Added identity and aptitude editing, optional first-morph assignment, and atomic IndexedDB persistence. Verified the ego and sleeve survive a browser reload.
